key_points: TD announced a CA$150bn five‑year commitment to lend/finance Canadian energy, critical minerals, defence, digital, AI and infrastructure projects.
WSJ reported TD mobilized >$108bn of that pledge, supporting nation‑building capex estimated up to $1.2trn by 2035.
Generic TSX market move shows modest index gain; not specific to TD.
A second investor alleges fraudulent trades in an obscure Chinese stock involving TD, raising potential legal/reputational risk.
Net effect likely modestly positive as growth initiative outweighs isolated allegation.
